_meta.purpose: Agreed target wording per source term, for the term_consistency class in check_translation_integrity.py.
_meta.shape: <source term, lowercased> -> <locale> -> [accepted renderings]. An entry whose msgid contains the term and whose msgstr contains none of the renderings is reported.
_meta.scope: Only terms listed here are checked. Add a locale once its wording is settled; leaving it out is not a failure.
